text: The Patriots head to Miami on Sunday at 4:15 PM ET looking to bounce back after a 30-24 loss to the Bears in which Caleb Williams threw two touchdown passes, and the good news is that Mike Reiss reports the starting secondary will be healthy for the matchup, though Mike Vrabel has emphasized that improving the team's turnover differential remains critical to their success—one of his four pillars of team identity that New England has been struggling with lately—while running back Rhamondre Stevenson continues doing the little things that add up, approaching 100 carries for the sixth straight season; meanwhile, Rob Gronkowski will be inducted into the Patriots Hall of Fame on Saturday, November 7 at 1 PM at Patriot Place Plaza, and ESPN's NFL survivor pool strategists are actually recommending the Patriots as one of their top six Week 8 picks.
